name: AI Resume Builder - Gemini, Email Automation & WordPress

parameters.content:
## 🚀 1. Form Input & Validation
Receives candidate form submission via POST webhook from the web application. Validates required fields, email format, and numeric experience.

## 🧠 2. Google Gemini AI Engine
Selects the visual theme and prepares a structured prompt directing Google Gemini to engineer an ATS-friendly, executive resume with categorized skills, quantifiable achievements, and projects.

## 🎨 3. HTML Resume & Email Synthesis
Parses Gemini JSON response and converts it into a responsive, print-ready HTML resume with matching theme typography, colors, and banner. Also constructs the responsive HTML email template for the user.

## 📧 4. Delivery & Webhook Response
Dispatches the generated resume directly to the candidate's email address and returns 200 Success JSON with the resume HTML back to the browser application for instant live rendering.
